The '''Quesh system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] that was located in [[Hutt Space/Legends|Hutt Space]].<ref name="Atlas Companion" /> It contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Quesh]], which was discovered by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the [[Great Galactic War]].<ref name="The Holonet" />
